reserves.name: Australian-dollar reserves at regulated financial institutions

sources.label: Forte AUD reserve and transparency disclosure

reserveReview.rationale: Forte states that each AUDF corresponds one-for-one to Australian-dollar reserves held with regulated financial institutions. The current public transparency page does not expose institution-level weights or a cash-versus-cash-equivalent breakdown, so the reserve is retained as one aggregate bank-account basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Forte AUD reserve disclosure; provider-level allocation undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve currency and regulated-institution placement are disclosed, but current institutions, provider shares, account terms, and any cash-equivalent allocation are not public.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: Australian-dollar reserves at regulated financial institutions
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Forte does not publish current institution-level or instrument-level reserve weights.

sources.label: Forte AUD reserve and transparency disclosure

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer describes regulated financial-institution custody but does not identify the institutions, disclose shares, or establish segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms on the reviewed current page.
